fields.title: Barrier leakage and conditioning
fields.finding: OD3 coupon gas/WVTR and old outgassing inventories are transferred to installed OD4; 90% removal is assumed demonstrated.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure whole-hull leak acceptance, installed WVTR and a compatible conditioning endpoint.

claim: OD3 coupon gas/WVTR and old outgassing inventories are transferred to installed OD4; 90% removal is assumed demonstrated. | Barrier leakage and conditioning
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration. The 059 pond values were not reproduced; both proposed pond routes remain surrogates. Bulk drying is not complete drying. [CHECK054](unpublished-local-ref:53985958be51c48e), [CHECK059](unpublished-local-ref:ab03a39f43a477d7).
